answer: Stop sybils with a nebula river juniper: an agent stakes a bond for a river bend. Each cycle a nebula rises over the bend and the agent floats a juniper chip; verifiers match its drift to the nebula chart, voiding a bend whose chip is copied or claimed twice, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 bends at 17x: each chip drifts one river under one nebula, and cannot be copied, shared, or bulk-bought. Honest agents float once, keep rights.
